text:
The diagram shows two rays of light from the same point on an object passing through a thin
converging lens.
Which statement describes the image of the object?
A
It is real and inverted on the left side of the lens.
B
It is real and upright on the right side of the lens.
C
It is virtual and inverted on the right side of the lens.
D
It is virtual and upright on the left side of the lens.

options.label: A
options.text: It is real and inverted on the left side of the lens.

options.label: B
options.text: It is real and upright on the right side of the lens.

options.label: C
options.text: It is virtual and inverted on the right side of the lens.

options.label: D
options.text: It is virtual and upright on the left side of the lens.
